name: Uplift
description: Gene-raised from animal stock. Do not mention the lab.
long_description: Somewhere between a court ruling and a war crime, the uplift programmes gave animal genomes a seat at the table. Uplifts are stronger than they look and they look very strong; the senses came along for free. They pay for it in paperwork and in people asking what they were 'before', which is a rude question with a short answer.
